contamination.verdict_detail: The three admissible blocks ran back-to-back on 177.25.26.1 (rack06os6) with two zero-process idle-gate samples before each launch, zero foreign dies in every metadata_before/metadata_after proc-mem table, and postflight leftover NONE.  The only process-table entry outside the gates is a 423 MB PID on NPU 0 in the r2 metadata_after board snapshot (14:25:17Z), 3 s after the measured window closed and 6 s before the worker exited: it is the benchmark's own rank0 winding down, not a foreign user, and it touches no measured row.  No rows are discarded.

board_process_table_transient.why_not_foreign: The rank bodies report container PIDs 11531/11532 and the r2 worker exited at 14:25:23Z; the board snapshot is 3 s after the last measured sample (14:25:13.831Z) and shows Aicore usage 0 % / HBM 4 % on the same die, i.e. a context winding down.  The proc_mem query at the same phase says 'No process in device', and the 14:25:44Z postflight is empty on both dies.

clock.reading: Every die is at 1650 MHz in all three measurement windows; 100 MHz idle samples exist only before warmup and after the last condition.  AICore usage oscillates 0-98 % and tracks the benchmark's own HCCL/canary work, not a foreign process (the same oscillation is present at W=2 with no foreign process at either gate).

device_stall_tail.explanation: A stalled sample inflates device-event batch_ms while host_wall_ms tracks it (ratio 1.00-1.03), and the stall lands on the same sample index on up to all eight ranks at once: the device stopped, the host did not.  Cause is not recoverable from the salvaged records.  Consequence: per-condition medians and cross-rank agreement are unaffected (median spread 1.8 %, worst 28.6 % on the worst P2P cell); means and pooled CVs are not usable.
device_stall_tail.unexcluded_foreign_touch: proc-mem was sampled at 14:16:25Z / 14:17:30Z, 14:20:41Z / 14:21:47Z and 14:23:16Z / 14:24:22Z (plus each parent's metadata_before/after and the postflight), all zero, so a foreign NPU process is excluded at those instants; a short foreign touch inside a 12-20 s window is not excluded by boundary sampling alone.  The in-window npu-smi clock samples show 0-98 % AICore oscillation consistent with the benchmark's own HCCL/canary work, not a steady foreign load.

a5_rack08.note: separate stack (npu-smi 26.2.0.b020 / fw 9.2.0.101.200 / CANN 9.2.0 / torch_npu 2.10.0.post7); used for comparison only, never pooled

comparison.reading: All rows are measured all-reduce/collective fits under the same affine convention. A5-rack08 is a different stack (driver 26.2.0.b020, fw 9.2.0.101.200, CANN 9.2.0) and is compared, never pooled.  The rack06 W=8 all-reduce marginal rate (160.8 GB/s) is 13 % above rack08's 142.2 GB/s, while W=2 all-reduce (47.5 GB/s) is identical within 0.2 %, and the single die-pair P2P rate is 50.8 GB/s on both: the die-pair path is stack-invariant, the 8-rank reduction/all-gather algorithm is not.  rack06 all-gather (45.2 GB/s) is 37 % below rack08 (72.0 GB/s) and reduce-scatter is 8 % below (37.9 vs 41.3 GB/s), which is consistent with a CANN 9.1.0 HCCL algorithm difference rather than a fabric difference.  A5 W=2 all-reduce remains slower than A3 W=2 SIO/HCCS_SW (105-122 GB/s) because two ranks use one die-pair path, exactly as on rack08.

gaps.detail: The 2-node block a5-comm-2n-r2x2-c1 (head 177.25.26.1, node2 177.25.27.1, 2 ranks/node) never launched: the idle gate on os7 returned 'busy' and the head's second sample was empty, so the driver aborted at 14:27:58Z.  The results directory is empty.  No W>8 or cross-host value is published and no rack08/A2/A3 inter-node number is substituted.
W=2, 4 and 8 were measured; W=16 needs the missing 2-node leg.  No interpolation rule was measured, so none is published.
bf16 only; the msprof engine phase produced no block in any salvaged parent record, so engine == not_observed.  No fp8/HiSparse engine point exists.

gaps.gap: collectives with no repo lane mode
gaps.detail: all_gather, reduce_scatter and all_to_all are measured here but a3_communication.CommCondition only has all_reduce_only / p2p_only / all_reduce_plus_p2p; they are published as measured rows and excluded from comm_conditions rather than forced into all_reduce_only.

the A2/A3 campaigns measured the overlapped MC2 lane; this campaign ran each collective in isolation, so the UB overlap/contention rule is still unknown (comm.py keeps UB channel_semantics == unknown).

t(bytes) is non-affine across 1MiB-4MiB (all-gather/all-reduce cross over); the affine fit carries 10-20 % in-band error there and fits_regime refuses to predict the band.  A finer sweep (0.5/2/8 MiB) plus the selected HCCL algorithm would model it.
repetitions=1 conditions have a much larger per-op cost than the fitted alpha; they are published as launch-inclusive evidence and excluded from the fit, matching the A2/A3 convention.

2.27 % of pooled samples exceed 2x their condition median (worst 48.4x), 98.2 % device-side and rank-synchronised; medians and rank agreement are unaffected.  A per-second npu-smi process/plog sampler during the window would attribute it.
P2P 1KiB rank spread is 27.4 % (rank0 vs rank1) and all-gather 1KiB 20.2 %; the pooled median is used, not the mean.  The 1KiB P2P point is below the launch-noise floor of this protocol.
